recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not add redundant Goal prose or pre-empt Observation-side text under FHIR-8254; reconcile FHIR-57447 separately only if OO finalizes it.
issue_request: FHIR-8254 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the DSTU1 core Goal issue asking to link an Observation to the Goal it measures against; Jira comments say this needed an Observation-to-Goal extension and was a specialization of FHIR-6019.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly named FHIR-8254, but Jira cites SVN #6806. Git commit 8bd3bd917d537625fad908b5f0f6277d113b941e maps to build@6806 and added the original pertainsToGoal extension with Reference(Goal) plus Observation measurement requirements.
additional_context: FHIR-6019 defines the common extension request. FHIR-13895 later renamed/moved the extension to resource-pertainsToGoal, all extensions were externalized to hl7.fhir.uv.extensions, and FHIR-53828 later added the current Goal note after Goal.outcome removal. FHIR-48360 supports using the extension instead of adding first-class Goal/Observation references; FHIR-57447 is only a Submitted OO follow-up.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope Goal notes already link resource-pertainsToGoal and name Observation as an example, while the Extension Pack definition provides the Goal reference target and usage semantics.
